sectionTitle: The Anatomy of a Couture Canvas
sectionSubtitle: Deconstruct a high-fashion couture gown illustration across 8 registered Procreate stages — from 10-head anatomical croquis to sculptural chiaroscuro and diamond sequin glaze.

layers.name: STAGE 01 : Heads Croqui
layers.description: Foundational 10-head fashion croquis calibrated with horizontal measurement rules and handwritten anatomical landmarks from 1 (chin), 1⅓ (shoulder), 2 (bust), and 3 (waist) down to 6.5 (knee), 9 (ankle), and 10 (toe).
layers.techniqueTip: Lock the vertical center-of-gravity plumb line through the pit of the neck before extending the poised left-hand gesture and 10-head lower-leg elongation.

layers.name: STAGE 02 : Silhouette
layers.description: Bold charcoal contour drafting over the 10-head mannequin—defining the plunging V-neck bodice, structured long sleeves, high thigh slit, architectural platform heel, and sweeping floor-length train.
layers.techniqueTip: Increase pencil pressure along the outer thigh slit and pooling floor hem to anchor the physical weight of the gown against the studio floor.

layers.name: STAGE 03 : Under Painting
layers.brush: Flat Gouache Wash & Precision Lasso Fill
layers.description: Unified warm honey-ochre and drystone clay skin flats blocked cleanly across the face, plunging décolletage, extended hand, and elongated leg within the high slit while preserving crisp garment masking.
layers.techniqueTip: Lay down a unified warm golden skin base beneath the charcoal linework so subsequent anatomical shading and highlights blend seamlessly.

layers.name: STAGE 04 : Body Rendering
layers.brush: Soft Sable Blender, Fine Hair Rake & Mesh Stamp
layers.technique: Anatomical Shading, Hair Waves & Cylinder Mesh Warp
layers.description: Complete sculptural rendering of the muse—voluminous honey-blonde waves, expressive eyes, heart-cut diamond pendant, soft bust and clavicle luminosity, fine fishnet stocking mesh, and gold-detailed platform heel.
layers.techniqueTip: Curve the fishnet stocking grid subtly across the calf and thigh contours so the mesh wraps naturally around the three-dimensional leg cylinder.

layers.name: STAGE 05 : Garment Color
layers.brush: Heavy Opaque Couture Fill & Soft Tapered Shader
layers.description: Rich espresso-mahogany base pigment flooding the couture gown and dramatic floor train, contrasted with a warm bronze-clay interior silk lining inside the slit to frame the leg in depth.
layers.techniqueTip: Keep the interior gown lining two tonal values lighter and warmer than the outer shell to immediately separate foreground drape from the back train.

layers.name: STAGE 06 : Fabric Texture
layers.brush: Custom Stipple Sequin & Metallic Bouclé Grain
layers.description: Dense copper-bronze and roasted cocoa micro-stipple texture layered across the entire gown silhouette, transforming the flat base into a tactile, light-catching beaded couture textile.
layers.techniqueTip: Apply the metallic grain on a Clipping Mask across the silhouette first, then lightly feather the edges so the texture follows the garment's turn.

layers.name: STAGE 07 : Chiaroscuro
layers.brush: Dry Oil Pastel Shader & Luminous Bronze Glaze
layers.description: Sculptural chiaroscuro modeling across the textured gown—sweeping warm copper, drystone clay, and rose-bronze highlights over the bodice, hip curve, and undulating train crests while deepening recessed fold valleys.
layers.techniqueTip: Focus the warmest bronze-champagne sheen along structural tension points—the waist cinch, upper thigh slit crest, and primary floor-train folds.

layers.name: STAGE 08 : Final Glaze
layers.technique: Selective Specular Glints & Floor Shadow Grounding
layers.description: Master finishing glaze igniting diamond-white star flares and pinpoint sequin reflections across the plunging neckline, sculpted hip, and cascading train folds, anchored by a soft studio floor shadow.
layers.techniqueTip: Reserve pure star-burst flares strictly for fold crests where sequin clusters face the studio key light directly—restraint creates maximum brilliance.
